content:
Jimmy Kimmel on Thursday tore into President Donald Trump for being part of a room of “diabolical villainy” as he met with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in China this week.

“Things got off to a bumpy start when Trump was disappointed to learn that Panda Express is not a real train,” Kimmel cracked.

Critics slammed Trump for meeting with Putin, who most Western leaders have avoided since he launched his war on Ukraine in February 2022. Trump, however, greeted Putin warmly and praised his meeting with Putin and Xi as “a 12” out of 10, while Putin said it went better than anyone expected.

“How is that possible?” a bewildered Kimmel asked. “At this point, what more could Trump possibly give him? Alaska?”

He said it’s “embarrassing” to see Trump get chummy with strongmen such as Putin.

“Russia is our enemy. They don’t like us,” Kimmel said. “They are bombing our allies going on now for almost five years.”

Kimmel was also stunned by how Trump greeted Putin when he first walked into the room.

“How is that OK with anyone?” Kimmel asked. “Vladimir Putin is a terrible person. He’s a brutal dictator. He is a murderer. He kills people. He poisons them. He has them shoved out of windows. But I guess that’s all OK because...”

He rolled the clip again of Trump saying: “He’s my friend.”

That led Kimmel to one observation just for Trump’s MAGA supporters.

“Even if you voted for this guy, you have to admit he has the worst taste in friends,” Kimmel said, then showed an image of the president with another former friend: late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
